layout: Training-time banks=1/2/4/8: double if projected load>8*banks and next bank width>=128. Proof uses 1/4 of total coefficients, value uses 3/4. Independent pair phase correlator; no label-informed routing, exact membership table or runtime resizing.
budget: Same D complex128 coefficients plus 2048 padded metadata bytes per learned mask in all five modes. MemoryBlock bytes, BankedMemory tuple/objects and fixed 32*4096 byte cache have equal measured owned-heap size. Microbenchmark disables cache in all modes. Interpreter RSS, semantic codec, Model metadata and transient query workspaces are outside this matched subsystem; peak tracemalloc is measured separately, not gated equal.
data: Unchanged v0.5 data: 576/192/192 train/development/evaluation and four 432-pair fits withholding one order/polarity cell. Same known parts in new combinations. Reused project data, not a new blind corpus. No corpus/fold label or expected evaluation output enters fit or recall.
development: Prototype D128/512/2048,N32/128/256 showed lower missing false accepts but lower correct coverage. No thresholds or allocation tuned after this protocol freeze. Development results are exploratory, not held-out evidence.
gates: Every standard split_proof bucket exact rate>=.98 and correct count equal to matched single; zero wrong outputs, invalid accepts and unrecoverable accepted packets; fixed subsystem bytes; active bank splitting. In isolated normal load aggregate, split_proof missing false accepts and known wrong accepts must be less than single, and known correct count at least .5 of single (explicit permissive tradeoff guard, not a quality target). At D8192,N<=32 each seed known exact>=.98. At block level split_proof can only remove outputs of same-weight split_unchecked; general multi-mask or end-to-end subset monotonicity is NOT assumed. All memory errors and abstentions remain recorded. Ordinary dictionary reference is measured, not equal-budget. No-learning and full-training regressions included.
limits: No guarantee against adversarial routing collisions
No multiple events or long documents
No explicit S1 chips/synchronization or P1 partial-observation integration
No R1 inference or Concept update
